verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο δεῖ περισσοτέρως προσέχειν ἡμᾶς τοῖς ἀκουσθεῖσιν μή‿ ποτε παραρυῶμεν
verses.transliteration: Dia touto dei perissoterōs prosechein hēmas tois akoustheisin mē pote pararyōmen
verses.literal: We must pay closer attention therefore . . . to what we have heard so that we do not drift away
verses.literalPt: PORTANTO, convém-nos atentar com mais diligência para as coisas que já temos ouvido, para que em tempo algum nos desviemos delas.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ ὁ δι’ ἀγγέλων λαληθεὶς λόγος ἐγένετο βέβαιος καὶ πᾶσα παράβασις καὶ παρακοὴ ἔλαβεν ἔνδικον μισθαποδοσίαν
verses.transliteration: ei gar ho di’ angelōn lalētheis logos egeneto bebaios kai pasa parabasis kai parakoē elaben endikon misthapodosian
verses.literal: For if the message spoken by angels was binding and every transgression and disobedience received its just punishment
verses.literalPt: Porque, se a palavra falada pelos anjos permaneceu firme, e toda a transgressão e desobediência recebeu a justa retribuição,

verses.original: πῶς ἡμεῖς ἐκφευξόμεθα τηλικαύτης ἀμελήσαντες σωτηρίας ἥτις ἀρχὴν λαβοῦσα λαλεῖσθαι διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ὑπὸ τῶν ἀκουσάντων εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐβεβαιώθη
verses.transliteration: pōs hēmeis ekpheuxometha tēlikautēs amelēsantes sōtērias hētis archēn labousa laleisthai dia tou Kyriou hypo tōn akousantōn eis hēmas ebebaiōthē
verses.literal: how shall we escape if we neglect such a great salvation This salvation was first announced by the Lord was confirmed to us by those who heard Him
verses.literalPt: Como escaparemos nós, se não atentarmos para uma tão grande salvação, a qual, começando a ser anunciada pelo Senhor, foi-nos depois confirmada pelos que a ouviram;

verses.original: συνεπιμαρτυροῦντος τοῦ Θεοῦ σημείοις τε καὶ τέρασιν καὶ ποικίλαις δυνάμεσιν καὶ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου μερισμοῖς κατὰ τὴν αὐτοῦ θέλησιν
verses.transliteration: synepimartyrountos tou Theou sēmeiois te kai terasin kai poikilais dynamesin kai Pneumatos Hagiou merismois kata tēn autou thelēsin
verses.literal: and was affirmed by God through signs wonders various miracles and gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to His will
verses.literalPt: Testificando também Deus com eles, por sinais, e milagres, e várias maravilhas e dons do Espírito Santo, distribuídos por sua vontade?

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ ἀγγέλοις ὑπέταξεν τὴν οἰκουμένην τὴν μέλλουσαν περὶ ἧς λαλοῦμεν
verses.transliteration: Ou gar angelois hypetaxen tēn oikoumenēn tēn mellousan peri hēs laloumen
verses.literal: For it is not to angels that He has subjected the world to come about which we are speaking
verses.literalPt: Porque não foi aos anjos que sujeitou o mundo futuro, de que falamos.

verses.original: διεμαρτύρατο δέ πού τις λέγων Τί ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὅτι μιμνῄσκῃ αὐτοῦ ἢ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ὅτι ἐπισκέπτῃ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: diemartyrato de pou tis legōn Ti estin anthrōpos hoti mimnēskē autou ē huios anthrōpou hoti episkeptē auton
verses.literal: But somewhere it is testified . . . in these words What is man that You are mindful of him or the son of man that You care for him
verses.literalPt: Mas em certo lugar testificou alguém, dizendo: Que é o homem, para que dele te lembres? Ou o filho do homem, para que o visites?

verses.original: ἠλάττωσας αὐτὸν βραχύ τι παρ’ ἀγγέλους δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφάνωσας αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ēlattōsas auton brachy ti par’ angelous doxē kai timē estephanōsas auton
verses.literal: You made him a little lower . . . . . . . . . than the angels You crowned him with glory and honor
verses.literalPt: Tu o fizeste um pouco menor do que os anjos, De glória e de honra o coroaste, E o constituíste sobre as obras de tuas mãos;

verses.original: πάντα ὑπέταξας ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ Ἐν τῷ γὰρ ὑποτάξαι αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα οὐδὲν ἀφῆκεν αὐτῷ ἀνυπότακτον νῦν δὲ οὔπω ὁρῶμεν αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα ὑποτεταγμένα
verses.transliteration: panta hypetaxas hypokatō tōn podōn autou En tō gar hypotaxai autō ta panta ouden aphēken autō anypotakton nyn de oupō horōmen autō ta panta hypotetagmena
verses.literal: and placed everything under his feet When God subjected all things to him He left nothing outside of his control . . . Yet at present we do not see everything subject to him
verses.literalPt: Todas as coisas lhe sujeitaste debaixo dos pés. Ora, visto que lhe sujeitou todas as coisas, nada deixou que lhe não esteja sujeito. Mas agora ainda não vemos que todas as coisas lhe estejam sujeitas.

verses.original: τὸν δὲ βραχύ τι παρ’ ἀγγέλους ἠλαττωμένον βλέπομεν Ἰησοῦν διὰ τὸ πάθημα τοῦ θανάτου δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφανωμένον ὅπως χάριτι Θεοῦ ὑπὲρ παντὸς γεύσηται θανάτου
verses.transliteration: ton de brachy ti par’ angelous ēlattōmenon blepomen Iēsoun dia to pathēma tou thanatou doxē kai timē estephanōmenon hopōs chariti Theou hyper pantos geusētai thanatou
verses.literal: But we see Jesus who was made a little lower . . . than the angels now crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone
verses.literalPt: Vemos, porém, coroado de glória e de honra aquele Jesus que fora feito um pouco menor do que os anjos, por causa da paixão da morte, para que, pela graça de Deus, provasse a morte por todos.

verses.original: Ἔπρεπεν γὰρ αὐτῷ δι’ ὃν τὰ πάντα καὶ δι’ οὗ τὰ πάντα πολλοὺς υἱοὺς εἰς δόξαν ἀγαγόντα τὸν ἀρχηγὸν τῆς σωτηρίας αὐτῶν διὰ παθημάτων τελειῶσαι
verses.transliteration: Eprepen gar autō di’ hon ta panta kai di’ hou ta panta pollous huious eis doxan agagonta ton archēgon tēs sōtērias autōn dia pathēmatōn teleiōsai
verses.literal: In bringing many sons to glory it was fitting for God for whom - and through whom all things exist to make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering
verses.literalPt: Porque convinha que aquele, para quem são todas as coisas, e mediante quem tudo existe, trazendo muitos filhos à glória, consagrasse pelas aflições o príncipe da salvação deles.

verses.original: ὅ τε γὰρ ἁγιάζων καὶ οἱ ἁγιαζόμενοι ἐξ ἑνὸς πάντες δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν οὐκ ἐπαισχύνεται ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοὺς καλεῖν
verses.transliteration: ho te gar hagiazōn kai hoi hagiazomenoi ex henos pantes di’ hēn aitian ouk epaischynetai adelphous autous kalein
verses.literal: For both the One who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are of the same family So . . . . . . Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers
verses.literalPt: Porque, assim o que santifica, como os que são santificados, são todos de um; por cuja causa não se envergonha de lhes chamar irmãos,

verses.original: λέγων Ἀπαγγελῶ τὸ ὄνομά σου τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου ἐν μέσῳ ἐκκλησίας ὑμνήσω σε
verses.transliteration: legōn Apangelō to onoma sou tois adelphois mou en mesō ekklēsias hymnēsō se
verses.literal: He says I will proclaim Your name to My brothers I will sing Your praises . . . in . . . the assembly
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Anunciarei o teu nome a meus irmãos, Cantar-te-ei louvores no meio da congregação.

verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν Ἐγὼ ἔσομαι πεποιθὼς ἐπ’ αὐτῷ Καὶ πάλιν Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ καὶ τὰ παιδία ἅ μοι ἔδωκεν ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: Kai palin Egō esomai pepoithōs ep’ autō Kai palin Idou egō kai ta paidia ha moi edōken ho Theos
verses.literal: And again I will put My trust in Him And once again Here am I and the children - God has given Me
verses.literalPt: E outra vez: Porei nele a minha confiança. E outra vez: Eis-me aqui a mim, e aos filhos que Deus me deu.

verses.original: Ἐπεὶ οὖν τὰ παιδία κεκοινώνηκεν αἵματος καὶ σαρκός καὶ αὐτὸς παραπλησίως μετέσχεν τῶν αὐτῶν ἵνα διὰ τοῦ θανάτου καταργήσῃ τὸν τὸ κράτος ἔχοντα τοῦ θανάτου τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τὸν διάβολον
verses.transliteration: Epei oun ta paidia kekoinōnēken haimatos kai sarkos kai autos paraplēsiōs meteschen tōn autōn hina dia tou thanatou katargēsē ton to kratos echonta tou thanatou tout’ estin ton diabolon
verses.literal: Now since the children have flesh and blood He too . . . shared in their humanity so that by His death He might destroy him who holds the power of death that is the devil
verses.literalPt: E, visto como os filhos participam da carne e do sangue, também ele participou das mesmas coisas, para que pela morte aniquilasse o que tinha o império da morte, isto é, o diabo;

verses.original: καὶ ἀπαλλάξῃ τούτους ὅσοι φόβῳ θανάτου διὰ παντὸς τοῦ ζῆν ἔνοχοι ἦσαν δουλείας
verses.transliteration: kai apallaxē toutous hosoi phobō thanatou dia pantos tou zēn enochoi ēsan douleias
verses.literal: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death
verses.literalPt: E livrasse todos os que, com medo da morte, estavam por toda a vida sujeitos à servidão.

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ δή‿ που ἀγγέλων ἐπιλαμβάνεται ἀλλὰ σπέρματος Ἀβραὰμ ἐπιλαμβάνεται
verses.transliteration: Ou gar dē pou angelōn epilambanetai alla spermatos Abraam epilambanetai
verses.literal: For surely . . . it is not the angels He helps but the descendants of Abraham
verses.literalPt: Porque, na verdade, ele não tomou os anjos, mas tomou a descendência de Abraão.

verses.original: ὅθεν ὤφειλεν κατὰ πάντα τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ὁμοιωθῆναι ἵνα ἐλεήμων γένηται καὶ πιστὸς ἀρχιερεὺς τὰ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν εἰς τὸ ἱλάσκεσθαι τὰς ἁμαρτίας τοῦ λαοῦ
verses.transliteration: hothen ōpheilen kata panta tois adelphois homoiōthēnai hina eleēmōn genētai kai pistos archiereus ta pros ton Theon eis to hilaskesthai tas hamartias tou laou
verses.literal: For this reason He had to be made like His brothers in every way so that He might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God in order to make atonement for the sins of the people
verses.literalPt: Por isso convinha que em tudo fosse semelhante aos irmãos, para ser misericordioso e fiel sumo sacerdote naquilo que é de Deus, para expiar os pecados do povo.

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ γὰρ πέπονθεν αὐτὸς πειρασθείς δύναται τοῖς πειραζομένοις βοηθῆσαι
verses.transliteration: en hō gar peponthen autos peirastheis dynatai tois peirazomenois boēthēsai
verses.literal: Because . . . . . . He Himself suffered when He was tempted He is able to help those who are being tempted
verses.literalPt: Porque naquilo que ele mesmo, sendo tentado, padeceu, pode socorrer aos que são tentados.
